progression.narrative: The performance opens on A3 and dwells most on E in Hesar, Pt. 1. The line peaks at Fs4 (360.1 Hz) at 0:55.8. It closes on Fs4, not the tonic (Fs4 → Fs4 → Fs4 → Fs4 → Fs4 → Fs4).
